intro.text: A Fjordell arteth at the Derethi chapel in Kae who turns down Hrathen's offer to make him head arteth.

items.text: Already an arteth in Kae when Hrathen arrived, Thered impressed the gyorn, who offered him the post of head arteth. To Hrathen's astonishment he refused and would give no reason. Hrathen wondered if Fjon had made the priests soft, but decided Thered was more likely deferring to Dilaf's rising influence in the chapel.

appearance.text: Tall, strong and dark-haired, with a square face and a muscular build from his monastery training.
